headline: 今日娱乐：无新片上映，超级少女领跑热搜
headlineEn: Today's Entertainment: No New Releases, Supergirl Tops Trends
summary: 今日无电影上映，本周仅四部新片。热搜榜上《超级少女》《龙族》领先，《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》备受期待。
summaryEn: No movies released today, only four new films this week. Trending lists led by Supergirl and House of the Dragon, with Spider-Man: Freshman Year highly anticipated.
